entries.en: I was afraid you wouldn't make it in time, Shepard.
The final confrontation. I think we both expected it would end like this.
You've lost. You know that, don't you? In a few minutes, Sovereign will have full control of all the Citadel's systems. The relay will open. The Reapers will return.
You survived our encounter on Virmire. But I've changed since then. Improved. Sovereign has... upgraded me.
I suppose I should thank you, Shepard. After Virmire, I couldn't stop thinking about what you said. About Sovereign manipulating me. About indoctrination.
The doubts began to eat away at me. Sovereign sensed my hesitation. I was implanted to strengthen my resolve.
Now my doubts are gone. I believe in Sovereign completely. I understand that the Reapers need organics. Join us and Sovereign will find a place for you, too.
The relationship is symbiotic. Organic and machine intertwined, a union of flesh and steel. The strengths of both, the weaknesses of neither.
I am a vision of the future, Shepard. The evolution of all organic life. This is our destiny. Join Sovereign and experience a true rebirth!
Then you will die. And your companions. Everyone you know and love. Everyone you've ever met. Don't you understand? You will all die!
The Reapers can't be stopped. Not by the Protheans. Not by you. The cycle always continues.
You don't understand, Shepard. There is a place for organics in the new order. The Reapers need men and women of action. People like us.
Sovereign recognizes your value. You've impressed it. Surrender to the Reapers and you will be spared. Join us and we can find a place for you.
We can't stop it! Not forever. You saw the visions. You saw what happened to the Protheans. The Reapers are too powerful.
I had no choice! You saw the visions. You saw what happened to the Protheans! Surrender or death -- there are no other options!
Maybe you're right. Maybe there is still a chance for... unh!
The implants... Sovereign is too strong. I'm sorry. It's too late for me.
Goodbye, Shepard. Thank you.
You should have joined Sovereign when you had the chance!
In time for what?
I'm done arguing with you. Let's end this!
No more stalling, Saren. Let's finish this!
Let's end this.
Had to wipe out a few hundred of your followers along the way. Sorry if I kept you waiting.
I've still got a few tricks up my sleeve.
I'm heading to that master control panel. And you can't stop me.
You let Sovereign implant you? Are you insane?
Fancy hardware's not going to save you.
Sovereign's controlling you through your implants! Don't you see that?
I'd rather die than live like that.
Sovereign hasn't won yet. I can stop it from taking control of the station! Step aside and the invasion will never happen!
The Reapers don't use organics! They devour and discard them! As soon as the conquest is over, you'll be cast aside!
The Reapers don't use organics! They devour and discard them. As soon as the conquest is over, you'll be cast aside!
Some part of you must still realize this is wrong. You can fight this!
You could have resisted. You could have fought! Instead, you surrendered. You quit.
In time?
I'm here now.
Killing geth is slow work.
I can stop them.
Not this time.
Out of my way!
What have you done?
It won't help.
You're indoctrinated!
As a slave?
We can beat them!
They'll betray you!
Enough talk!
Don't give in to them!
You gave up!
This is pointless.
You're still dead.
Ugh... argh.
It's not over yet. You can still redeem yourself!
There's still one way to stop this... if you've got the guts.
That's not true!
It's never too late.
The Citadel is mine, Shepard! You cannot stop me.
You have no idea what stands before you. I am not Saren. This form is only a shell. A vessel to channel my power!
Looks like Saren got more than he bargained for with those upgrades.
Looks like Saren got more than he bargained for.
This flesh repulses me. It is vulnerable. Fragile. Weak. Like all organic life. My kind knows true strength: the strength of metal and steel.
We are aware of your presence. We tolerate your existence. But you are less than insects to us. You are bacteria. Germs.
We are the pinnacle of creation! Immortal. Infallible. Perfect.
I am Sovereign! And this station is MINE!
You just don't know when to quit, do you?
This time I'll make sure you stay dead!
You're parasites, feeding off organic society. Without us, your kind couldn't survive!
Turian, Reaper, organic, machine -- I don't care what you are. I'm taking you down!
It might take every ship we've got, but we have to take that monster down!
You again?
Back for more?
You need us!
Time to die!
That's where you're wrong.
You are nothing.
He's dead.
He is dead.
Make sure he's dead.
Quick! Open the station's arms. Maybe the fleet can take Sovereign down before he regains control of the station!
Vigil's data file worked. I've got control of all systems.
Quick! Open the station's arms. Maybe the fleet can take Sovereign down!
... the Destiny Ascension. Main drives offline. Kinetic barriers down 40%. The Council is on board. I repeat, the Council is on board.
Normandy to the Citadel. Normandy to the Citadel. Please tell me that's you, Commander.
We can save the Ascension. Just unlock the relays around the Citadel and we'll send the cavalry in!
You were expecting someone else?
This is bigger than humanity. Sovereign's a threat to every organic species in the galaxy!
This is bigger than humanity! Sovereign's a threat to every organic species in the galaxy!
True. That's why you can't waste reinforcements trying to save the Council. You must hold them back until the Citadel arms open up and the human fleet can go after Sovereign!
The Council must be sacrificed for the greater good. Don't waste your reinforcements. Hold them back until the Citadel arms open up. Save the human fleet to attack Sovereign.
What's the order, Commander! Come in now to save the Ascension or hold back?
I hope you know what you're doing, Commander.
I hope the Council appreciates this.
The noble choice. I just hope it does not also turn out to be the wrong one.
I hope you know what you're doing, human. Don't let the Council die in vain.
A sacrifice for the greater good. I only pray it is not made in vain.
Let the Council die to save the galaxy. A tough decision. I hope you made the right choice.
Sacrifice the Council for the greater good? I sure hope you know what you're doing.
Sacrifice the Council to win the battle. A good plan, but only if it works.
You can't sacrifice human lives to save the Council! What have they ever done for us?
You'd sacrifice human lives to save the Council? What have they ever done for your kind?
Are you sure about this, Shepard? Human casualties will be very high if you send your fleet in now.
Exactly! We can't throw away reinforcements trying to save the Council. We have to hold them back until Sovereign's exposed!
That's why you can't throw away reinforcements trying to save the Council. Hold them back until the Citadel arms open up and the human fleet can go after Sovereign!
Exactly! We can't throw away reinforcements trying to save the Council. We have to hold them back until the Citadel arms open up and our fleet can go after Sovereign!
Hold off, Joker. We're not sacrificing human lives to save the Council. Keep our ships back until they can get a shot at Sovereign.
Opening the relays now, Joker. We need to save the Ascension -- no matter what the cost!
Wait until those arms open, Joker! We need all our ships focusing on Sovereign, even if it means sacrificing the Council.
File's loaded.
Save the Council.
Concentrate on Sovereign.
Let the Council die.
Of course.
See if you can open a communications channel.
We caught that distress call, Commander. I'm sitting here in the Andura sector with the entire Arcturus fleet.
I'm here, Joker.
It's me.
I read you.
Are you really willing to sacrifice human lives to save the Council, Shepard?
I hope you know what you're doing, Shepard.
You're willing to sacrifice the Council? I sure hope you know what you're doing, Commander.
